#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -u

OUT=/tmp/astra-remaining-phase-data-fixed-v1
SOURCE=/home/joshua/lonely-runner-formalization/scripts/remaining_phase_data.py

sha256sum "$SOURCE" >"$OUT/source.sha256.before"
timeout --foreground --kill-after=1s 65s /usr/bin/time -v -o "$OUT/controller.time" \
  python3 "$SOURCE" --execute --output-dir "$OUT/data" \
  >"$OUT/controller.stdout" 2>"$OUT/controller.stderr"
status=$?
printf '%s\n' "$status" >"$OUT/controller.exit"
sha256sum "$SOURCE" >"$OUT/source.sha256.after"
python3 - "$OUT" "$SOURCE" >"$OUT/retention.json" <<'PY'
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

out = Path(sys.argv[1])
source = Path(sys.argv[2])
witnesses = {
    out / "data" / "six_one_witnesses.bin",
    out / "data" / "six_four_witnesses.bin",
}
files = sorted(path for path in out.rglob("*") if path.is_file())
output_bytes = sum(path.stat().st_size for path in files)
witness_bytes = sum(path.stat().st_size for path in witnesses if path.exists())
inclusive_bytes = source.stat().st_size + output_bytes
nonwitness_bytes = inclusive_bytes - witness_bytes
record = {
    "source_bytes": source.stat().st_size,
    "output_bytes": output_bytes,
    "witness_bytes": witness_bytes,
    "inclusive_bytes": inclusive_bytes,
    "nonwitness_bytes": nonwitness_bytes,
    "inclusive_limit": 1048576,
    "nonwitness_limit": 65536,
    "within_limits": inclusive_bytes <= 1048576 and nonwitness_bytes <= 65536,
}
print(json.dumps(record, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")))
if not record["within_limits"]:
    raise SystemExit(2)
PY
retention_status=$?
printf '%s\n' "$retention_status" >"$OUT/retention.exit"
if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
  exit "$status"
fi
exit "$retention_status"
